dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
Meet Nelly! This sweet, gentle boy has the softest fur, the biggest eyes, and adorable grey marble stripes. He's a quiet, easygoing cat who gets along beautifully with other cats and never causes any trouble.

Nelly is still learning that people can be trusted, and he just needs a little time and patience to let his personality shine. He's a shy sweetheart who would thrive in a calm, loving home with adults or older children who will give him the space and encouragement he needs to feel safe. With the right family, Nelly has all the makings of a wonderful companion.
dog.name: Nelly
